{{Quote|Or Wrencess, a master seducer whose advances have never been rejected by anyone of any species. He spends weeks romancing his targets before revealing his true goal.|Ro-San Borokki, Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook|<ref name="Bounty" />}}
''' Wrencess''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] whose seductive advances were never rejected by any individual of any [[Species/Legends|species]]. To pursue [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], Wrencess would take [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] to romantically engage his targets before revealing his goal. Wrencess was mentioned in the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'s [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] edition in a section called "The Hunt," [[Author/Legends|written]] by [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Guild]] member [[Ro-San Borokki]]. The handbook used Wrencess as an example of the variety of approaches a bounty hunter could take to capture their targets.<ref name="Bounty" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wrencess was mentioned in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a [[2013]] [[in-universe]] reference book by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]], and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Bounty" />
